meta.title: Request to unlock a dormant PR

plan.title: Request Unlock for Dormant PR Line

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where eligible lines are shown.

args.goal: select a dormant-locked purchase requisition line, click Request to unlock, and stop with the line still visibly locked and the unlock request result available on screen

steps.note: Perform the catalog-unsupported dormant-line unlock request flow in the buyer session and verify the line remains locked.
